messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear MineWerx Team,

Your mining-focused executive search and leadership placement work across international operations makes this a strong fit for my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where mining growth depends on regulatory discipline, stakeholder trust and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
